input.prompt: A flat, evenly lit, straight-down close-up photograph of plain hand-woven cotton cloth, dyed a deep madder red, a warm brick red as in traditional alizarin vegetable dye, filling the entire frame edge to edge. Soft diffuse even light across the whole frame. Seamless textile texture.
